faqs.question: How do I get to Magoodhoo Island?
faqs.answer: Public ferry service operates weekly from Male (approximately 12 hours journey time). Private speedboat transfers can be arranged through guesthouses (approximately 5 hours from Male).

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Magoodhoo Island?
faqs.answer: The best time to visit Magoodhoo Island is during the northeast monsoon season (December to April), which brings dry, sunny weather with lower humidity and calmer seas. Water temperature remains warm (27-30°C/80-86°F) throughout the year.

faqs.question: What makes Magoodhoo different from other local islands in the Maldives?
faqs.answer: Magoodhoo stands out for its marine research station and unique blend of traditional island life with scientific study. Unlike other islands, Magoodhoo offers opportunities to learn about marine conservation while experiencing authentic Maldivian culture.

faqs.question: Can visitors participate in research activities on Magoodhoo?
faqs.answer: While formal research participation is typically limited to scientists and students, visitors may be able to join educational programs or tours of research facilities when available. Check with your guesthouse or the research station for current opportunities.

faqs.question: What marine life can I expect to see while snorkeling around Magoodhoo?
faqs.answer: Magoodhoo's waters offer excellent marine biodiversity, including healthy coral formations with both hard and soft corals. Common sightings include reef sharks, various ray species, abundant reef fish, and sea turtles. The house reef provides easy access to this underwater world directly from shore.
